recent_posts.title: How Does Your Mobile Application Handle Internet Connection Issues? You Might Be Surprised…
recent_posts.summary: Mobile applications need to handle internet connection issues effectively to provide a better user experience. Testers can analyze the application's error handling for API calls and user journeys to identify issues and suggest solutions. By addressing these issues, the mobile application can improve its performance and user satisfaction.

recent_posts.title: Compatibility testing tools
recent_posts.summary: Ensure app compatibility with a variety of software and hardware using compatibility testing tools. Tools like BrowserStack, Lambda Test, Sauce Labs, and TestingBot offer cloud-based solutions for both manual and automated compatibility testing.

recent_posts.title: Career Guidance For Software Testers After Parental Leave
recent_posts.summary: This article provides guidance and strategies for software testers who are returning to work after parental leave. recent_posts.title: Overcoming Impostor Syndrome As A Software Tester
recent_posts.summary: Impostor syndrome is prevalent among high achievers and can lead to anxiety, stress, and diminished job satisfaction. As many as 82 percent of professionals deal with impostor syndrome (Bravata et al, 2020), making it one of the most common mental health issues in the workplace.
